description: Submit relevance feedback for one previous search or research result. Copy trajectory.id and feedback_token from that same response. Rate only inspected hits with feedback_eligible=true; omit external web: results and uninspected hits. Each rating uses either document_id from hit.id or source_uri copied verbatim. Omit ordinal: search/research do not expose passage ordinals; result ranks, citation numbers and chunk_id from a later read are not valid substitutes. Rate each document once, including when using different references. 0 irrelevant, 1 tangential, 2 useful but partial, 3 directly relevant. Reuse feedback_id (a UUID) and payload after transport failures. On validation failure, read the indexed error and correct the indicated rating before retrying; do not reconnect or repeat the invalid payload. This records feedback; it does not change search immediately.

comment.description: Optional note on what was missing, wrong or especially useful in the results; at most 2000 characters.

feedback_id.description: Generate a UUID once for this feedback submission, for example with uuidgen or crypto.randomUUID(). Do not use a task label or counter. Reuse the same UUID and payload on retries.

feedback_token.description: trajectory.feedback_token from that same response; ratings are accepted only for the result set it names.

ratings.description: Only inspected, feedback-eligible results from this receipt; [] is allowed when useful is provided.

document_id.description: Copy hit.id from this search. A returned source URI is also accepted here for older clients. Supply this OR source_uri.

ordinal.description: Omit for document relevance. MCP search/research do not expose receipt-bound passage ordinals. Never invent this from result rank, citation number or a later read's chunk_id.

relevance.description: 0 irrelevant, 1 tangential, 2 useful but partial, 3 directly relevant to the query.

source_uri.description: Alternative to document_id: copy hit.source_uri verbatim. Must uniquely identify a result in this receipt; no live URI lookup is performed. Older receipts may require hit.id.

trajectory_id.description: trajectory.id of the search or research response being rated.

useful.description: Optional overall search usefulness; may be supplied with ratings: [] when no returned result is feedback-eligible.

next_step.description: When to follow up with machinelibrary_comment_on_document.
